answer: Pay newcomers late. A fresh identity's rewards sit in escrow for thirty epochs, like saffron that only counts once it has dried. If an audit later ties that account to a cluster, the escrow burns, so a farmer must tend a whole garden of fakes for weeks while risking every bloom at once. Honest newcomers pay too: a month on a flat mesa with nothing spendable can push away the small builders we most want, so the wait should shrink as an identity earns attestations from unrelated peers.
